At the start: Camera at the corridor end of the landing, facing the autumn landscape painting on the back wall. The landing has one pair of brushed-steel elevator doors on the left wall, closed. One tall walnut front door with a black smart lock stands on the right wall. One autumn landscape painting hangs above one slim console table on the back wall, between two brass wall sconces. Panel 5: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran's shoulder, from the corridor end on the elevator side, facing Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze tilts his head with a mocking grin and spreads one hand toward Ji Ran.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, slow push in on Ji Ran, eye level, from the corridor end on the front-door side. Ji Ran raises one brow and gives a cool, thin smile, her hand resting on the handbag strap.
Panel 7: Close-up, clean single on Lu Shaoze, tight on his face and shoulders, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end on the elevator side. Lu Shaoze's grin stiffens and his jaw tightens.
